description: Retrieves a specific lead by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields.

lead_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the lead to retrieve. Must be a Salesforce record ID (18-char format like '00QWd000005V3RmMAK'); names, emails, or external codes are not accepted — resolve to a Salesforce ID first using a search or query tool.
lead_id.human_parameter_description: The unique Salesforce ID of the lead you want to retrieve. You can find it in the lead’s URL—it usually starts with '00Q'.
lead_id.title: Lead Id
